tasks.verified: When the extraction verbatim copy carries no time signal (e.g. CJK garbled to nonsense), the gateway's time authorities fall back to the raw live message text, so a corrupted copy can never suppress a patient's stated day-part/relative/window/clock intent - proven at the handler seam with the cumulative suite grown past 180 tests.
tasks.spec:
ROLE: fix worker for the Mott booking gateway, lane 59 (live-text fallback for time authorities). Work entirely inside your CWD; never modify anything outside it; no network, no git, no MCP/Apps/skills, no deploys, do not load skills.

CONTEXT - measured live defect: after an English turn ('Thursday morning'), a patient wrote '下午' (afternoon). The LLM extraction verbatim-copy variable arrived at the gateway GARBLED as '一午' (下 corrupted to 一) - envelope-verified; the pure-Chinese conversation copies it faithfully. Because the verbatim string matched no day-part trigger, no afternoon window applied and the bot repeated morning slots. The gateway ALSO receives the raw message text (user_text plus, in production, the SMS history fetch) in live_text - which carried the true 下午. Current behavior: every verbatim time authority uses `verbatim_text or live_text`, i.e. live_text is consulted only when verbatim is EMPTY, so a garbled non-empty verbatim suppresses the signal.

SOURCE - copy /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workR26/gw-later-floor-zh/fixed-bland_gateway.py (byte-identical to the deployed lane-58 gateway) into your CWD as fixed-bland_gateway.py and edit that copy. Copy the cumulative test tree /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workR26/gw-later-floor-zh/gwtest into ./gwtest and extend it; every existing test must still pass.

THE FIX - SIGNAL-BASED FALLBACK in clamp_availability_range for the four verbatim time authorities (meridiem authority, clock-idiom authority, time-window authority, day-part authority incl. Chinese, and the later/earlier relative floor):
1. For each authority, evaluate with verbatim_text first exactly as today. If that authority found NO trigger in verbatim_text AND live_text is non-empty AND live_text != verbatim_text, re-evaluate that authority with live_text and use its result.
2. Precedence rules between authorities are unchanged (explicit extraction values win; anchor outranks day-part; latest outranks the relative floor; ordinal beats anaphor). A trigger found in verbatim always wins over anything in live_text for that authority.
3. The existing 'good <daypart>' greeting guard and all non-trigger guards apply to whichever text is being evaluated.
4. Implement without duplicating the authority bodies - e.g. a small helper that takes the authority callable and both texts, or evaluate each pure function on verbatim then live text. Keep the seam identical (same call site in clamp_availability_range).
5. DATE authorities (anaphoric week, ordinal, that-weekday) may be included with the same pattern if the refactor is clean, but the REQUIRED scope is the TIME authorities listed above - do not regress date behavior.

DELIVERABLES in CWD:
- fixed-bland_gateway.py (full edited file)
- proof_livetext_fallback.py - executable proof driving clamp_availability_range with full request bodies. Print exactly:
  CASE=garbled-zh-daypart AFTER=12:00 (body: from='thursday', user_verbatim='一午', user_text='下午', all windows none)
  CASE=verbatim-wins AFTER=16:00 (user_verbatim='晚上', user_text='早上' - verbatim signal beats live text)
  CASE=garbled-later-floor AFTER_GT=10:30 (user_verbatim='xx later xx'? NO - use: user_verbatim='一点晚' garble, user_text='晚一点', context_date='08/06/2026 10:30 am' -> floor strictly past 10:30)
  CASE=both-empty UNCHANGED=true (user_verbatim='', user_text='', no windows applied)
  CASE=explicit-still-wins AFTER=15:00 (user_verbatim='一午', user_text='下午', after='03:00 pm' - extraction window untouched)
  CASE=english-garble-window BEFORE=12:00 (user_verbatim='morninng typo mrnng', user_text='friday morning' - fallback catches the clean live text)
- ./gwtest extended with at least 6 new tests covering the fallback for day-part (zh + en), the relative floor, verbatim-beats-livetext, explicit-extraction-wins, and a regression that a clean verbatim path is byte-identical in behavior.
- DEBUG-GW59.md - what changed, where, the exact fallback rule, known limitations (e.g. live_text race one turn behind: worst case applies the PREVIOUS turn's stated time preference, which is the patient's last stated intent - acceptable by design ruling).

HARD RULES: do not weaken, remove or skip any existing test; keep all lane-51..58 behavior intact; keep the file runnable as the single gateway module it is; no placeholder code.
tasks.check: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 ./proof_livetext_fallback.py > proof.out 2>&1 || { echo 'FAIL: proof crashed'; tail -8 proof.out; exit 1; }; for c in 'CASE=garbled-zh-daypart AFTER=12:00' 'CASE=verbatim-wins AFTER=16:00' 'CASE=garbled-later-floor AFTER_GT=10:30' 'CASE=both-empty UNCHANGED=true' 'CASE=explicit-still-wins AFTER=15:00' 'CASE=english-garble-window BEFORE=12:00'; do grep -q "$c" proof.out || { echo "FAIL: missing $c"; cat proof.out; exit 1; }; done; grep -q 'resolve_anaphoric_week' fixed-bland_gateway.py && grep -q 'closed_day' fixed-bland_gateway.py || { echo 'FAIL: prior lane behavior lost'; exit 1; }; cd gwtest && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest -q > ../pytest.out 2>&1; rc=$?; cd ..; summary=$(tail -1 pytest.out); [ $rc -eq 0 ] || { echo "FAIL: suite red: $summary"; tail -10 pytest.out; exit 1; }; n=$(echo "$summary" | grep -oE '^[0-9]+'); [ "$n" -ge 180 ] || { echo "FAIL: only $n tests, floor is 180 (174 cumulative + 6 new)"; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: live-text fallback proven - $summary"
